en: Hello {contact}, the final acceptance letter for {name} is ready: {accepted} of {deliverables} deliverables are accepted. Please sign and return it.

en: The deliverable was planned for {col:deliverables.planned}. It was submitted on {col:deliverables.submitted_on} after {col:deliverables.attempts} submission(s) and accepted on {col:deliverables.accepted_on}, which took {col:deliverables.acc_days} days.
mt: यह {col:deliverables.planned} के लिए निर्धारित किया गया था। इसे {col:deliverables.submitted_on} पर प्रस्तुत किया गया था और {col:deliverables.accepted_on} को स्वीकार किया गया था, जिसमें {col:deliverables.acc_days} दिन लगे।

en: {col:projects.accepted} of {col:projects.deliverables} deliverables are accepted. The test pass rate is {col:projects.pass_rate}. There are {col:projects.defects_open} open defects, of which {col:projects.crit_open} are critical.
mt: {col:projects.accepted} के {col:projects.deliverables} deliverables स्वीकार किए जाते हैं. परीक्षण पास दर {col:projects.pass_rate} है. {col:projects.defects_open} खुले दोष हैं, जिनमें से {col:projects.crit_open} महत्वपूर्ण हैं.

en: We confirm that {col:projects.accepted} of {col:projects.deliverables} deliverables of the project are accepted. The project ended on {col:projects.actual_end}.

en: List every deliverable and milestone on Deliverables and the criteria the client checks on Acceptance Criteria. Log each submission and decision on Acceptance Log; days to decide and late checks fill in.
